required_fields.api_base: explicit endpoint URL; no default and no cross-provider fallback
required_fields.api_key_env: NAME of the environment variable holding the credential; the credential VALUE must never appear in route files, traces or logs

contract.reject_when_missing: the runner must raise before creating any client; no provider default, no fallback to another vendor, no silent retry against a different endpoint
contract.credential_handling: value is read from the named env var at runtime only; never logged; never hashed into reports (no key-derived values retained)
